about: RX 9070, 16 GB, ROCm 7.2 torch in ~/ComfyUI/.venv-rocm, over Thunderbolt 3 (needs amdgpu pcie_gen_cap=0x0007001F, or the card is held to PCIe Gen 1). SCAIL-2 loads as a Q5_K_M GGUF; umt5 runs on the CPU. Launch ComfyUI with: python main.py --reserve-vram 1 --use-pytorch-cross-attention --disable-smart-memory. Without --disable-smart-memory ComfyUI keeps ~12 GB of models on the card and the VAE decode runs out of memory; PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments crashes the GPU. Key art locally: CAG_LOCAL_COMFY_WORKFLOW=comfy/qwen-image-2.1-fp8.json (134 s warm, 2.9 s/step). No SCAIL video drawn on it yet.
